workouts.title: Push / Pull / Legs Hypertrophy Split
workouts.subtitle: Optimal frequency for muscle protein synthesis & joint recovery
workouts.description: Evidence-based periodization balancing heavy mechanical tension with moderate metabolic fatigue and built-in rotator cuff / hip stability.
workouts.warmupSummary: 5-min dynamic arm circles, band pull-aparts, thoracic rotations
workouts.cooldownSummary: Cervical stretches, pec doorway stretch, deep diaphragmatic decompression

workouts.title: Desk Worker Posture & Thoracic Decompression
workouts.subtitle: Counteract prolonged sitting, anterior pelvic tilt, and forward head posture
workouts.description: Targeted corrective movement to mobilize the thoracic spine, strengthen deep cervical flexors, and activate dormant gluteal muscles.
workouts.cooldownSummary: Child pose with lateral side reach 2 mins

workouts.title: Foundation Full Body Strength Split
workouts.subtitle: Multi-joint compound fundamentals with autoregulated rest intervals
workouts.description: Teaches primary movement patterns: squat, hinge, push, pull, and core anti-rotation with progressive overload tracking.
workouts.warmupSummary: World greatest stretch 5 per side, bird-dog 8 per side

exercises.name: Strict Push-Up
exercises.description: Horizontal pressing pattern developing upper-body muscular endurance while testing core anti-extension stability.
exercises.startingPosition: Hands just outside shoulder width, body in rigid plank from crown to heels.
cues: Rigid spine from head to heels
safetyInstructions: Keep elbows tucked at 45 degrees to protect anterior shoulder capsule.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exercises.description: Posterior chain builder teaching pure hip-hinge mechanics, maximizing eccentric hamstring loading with minimal shear.
exercises.startingPosition: Feet hip-width apart, dumbbells in front of thighs with neutral wrists.
cues: Squeeze lats to lock dumbbells along shins
safetyInstructions: Stop descent once pelvis ceases backward translation.

exercises.name: Cat-Camel Spinal Mobilization
exercises.description: Low-load rhythmic flexion and extension of the entire vertebral column to mobilize synovial fluid.
exercises.startingPosition: Quadruped on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
cues: Inhale into extension, exhale into flexion
safetyInstructions: Move gently within pain-free active range of motion.

mobilityRoutines.title: Desk Worker Thoracic Spine Decompression
mobilityRoutines.description: Counters kyphotic slouching and improves glenohumeral overhead mobility through segmental thoracic extension.
mobilityRoutines.precautions: Do not hyperextend lumbar spine. Maintain gentle core brace throughout.
mobilityRoutines.medicalDisclaimer: General educational routine. Discontinue if experiencing acute radiating pain or tingling.

mobilityRoutines.title: Deep Hip Rotator & Psoas Release
mobilityRoutines.description: Restores internal and external rotation of the femoral head, alleviating compensatory lumbar strain.
mobilityRoutines.precautions: Avoid aggressive pinching sensation in anterior hip capsule.
mobilityRoutines.medicalDisclaimer: Not a substitute for clinical hip impingement diagnosis.

nutritionArticles.title: Evidence-Based Protein Distribution for Active Adults
nutritionArticles.summary: How spacing 25–40g of complete leucine-rich protein across 3–4 meals maximizes muscle protein synthesis.
nutritionArticles.content: Distributing dietary protein evenly throughout the day provides repeated stimuli for muscle remodeling and recovery, especially when combined with progressive resistance training.

nutritionArticles.title: The Biomechanics of Hydration: Joint Cushioning & Force Output
nutritionArticles.summary: Even 2% dehydration impairs tendon elasticity and elevates perceived exertion during resistance exercise.
nutritionArticles.content: Synovial fluid within joints relies on adequate systemic hydration to lubricate cartilage. Maintaining consistent water intake helps cushion joint surfaces during heavy loading.

faqs.q: Is the PhysioFit Android APK safe to install on my device?
faqs.a: Yes, 100%. Every PhysioFit APK release is cryptographically signed with our verified private release key and scanned through automated vulnerability suites.

faqs.q: Why does Android warn about installing apps from unknown sources?
faqs.a: Android displays a standard security confirmation whenever an application is installed outside Google Play. PhysioFit is verified and contains zero adware or telemetry.

faqs.q: Does the mobile app sync with my PhysioFit web account?
faqs.a: Yes. All your logged workouts, personal records, customized routines, hydration metrics, and streak history sync seamlessly between the Android app and the PhysioFit Web application.
